transcript:
--- 26-10-09 C1 Happy - NIWRC Event 15.MP4 ---
[00:09.1] Kamakus, Katsiyawyo, and Niniputim, the language of the Nez Perce tribe, a huge thanks and
[00:15.1] gratitude to all of our donors.
[00:20.9] We could not do this work without them.
[00:26.2] I love that we all know how to play the political game.
--- 26-10-09 C2 Happy - NIWRC Event 9.MP4 ---
[00:04.1] Okay.
[00:23.1] Kamakus Katsiawya, in Nimibutim, the language of the Nez Perce tribe, a huge thanks and
[00:29.2] gratitude to all of our donors.
[00:35.0] We could not do this work without them.
[00:40.3] I love that we all know how to play the political game.
